notes: Bin 48 replaces the forced WAN link with the real RTL8221B Clause-45 PHY binding at MDIO address 6, restoring bidirectional 2.5 GbE and DHCP when WAN is configured as LAN on tested three-port and four-port K43P units. It retains Bin 47 PCIe-first modem detection, USB3 fallback, Wi-Fi status correction, and adds dual-bank upgrade handling for both misectel,m01k43 and alwaylink,m01k43 identifiers.
